Dridam

Released May 8, 2026 Malayalam 126 min UA

A rookie police officer arrives at a hill-station posting under intense pressure to solve a murder case within a week after human remains are discovered. A tightly-edited Malayalam investigative thriller from director Martin Joseph (debut) under Jeethu Joseph's Bedtime Stories banner.

★ Boxoffy Verdict · TRACKING
Mid-week Kerala opener — 7+ audience reviews praising Shane Nigam's restraint and Martin Joseph's editorial discipline. Critics note structural weakness in final act but film does not collapse. Path to recovery depends on Kerala weekend uplift + word-of-mouth.
